title: Allotment Watering Roster System
originalRequest: Design and deploy an automated allotment watering roster system that tracks volunteer schedules, integrates weather forecasts, sends reminders, and logs completed watering tasks.
latestMessage: Design and deploy an automated allotment watering roster system that tracks volunteer schedules, integrates weather forecasts, sends reminders, and logs completed watering tasks.

steps.title: Database Schema Definition
steps.instruction: Define the database schema for storing watering schedules, plot allocations, volunteer contact info, and historical watering logs. Request user approval on the proposed schema before proceeding.
steps.acceptance: Database schema is documented and approved by the user.

steps.title: Watering Zone and Plot Assignment
steps.instruction: Map out the physical watering zones and assign plots to volunteers. Prompt the user for the complete list of allotment plots and volunteer names.
steps.acceptance: Zones are defined and mapped to specific volunteer accounts in the system database.

steps.title: Weather API Integration
steps.instruction: Integrate a weather forecast service to dynamically adjust watering requirements based on precipitation forecasts. Ask the user for the preferred API provider and credentials.
steps.acceptance: Weather service adapter is implemented and correctly fetches forecast data to flag rainy days.

steps.title: Notification System Configuration
steps.instruction: Set up automated reminders via email or SMS for scheduled volunteers. Present draft email templates to the user for feedback and approval.
steps.acceptance: Notification engine is integrated and ready to send messages based on template designs.

steps.title: Volunteer Mobile Portal
steps.instruction: Develop a lightweight mobile-friendly frontend for volunteers to log completed watering tasks and report issues. Present wireframes to the user for validation.
steps.acceptance: Frontend application matches the approved wireframes and connects to the backend API.

steps.title: Deployment Setup
steps.instruction: Configure the deployment environment and CI/CD pipeline for the watering roster. Request hosting platform details and target environment credentials from the user.
steps.acceptance: Application is successfully deployed to the target production environment and verified accessible.
